answer_1.quote: PlugIR comprises two key components: context reformulation and context-aware dialogue generation. ... we utilize LLMs to convert dialogues into a format (e.g., caption-style) more aligned with the training data distribution of the retrieval models. ... the retrieval system generates a question Q_t about the target image.

answer_2.quote: We report the results mainly with two metrics: Hits@10 and our proposed BRI. ... We also compare using Recall@K, MRR@10, and NDCG@10.

answer_3.quote: For each question generated by the questioner, we prompt an LLM agent to respond with 'uncertain' if it cannot derive an answer from the corresponding description and dialogue, which implies the question is free from redundancy.

answer_4.quote: We engage 30 human testers to measure human preference for interactive text-to-image retrieval systems ... human testers are required to answer ... Q1. The system will be effective. (Yes: 5, No: 1) Q2. The system will be efficient. (Yes: 5, No: 1)
answer_4.guideline: Testers evaluate system effectiveness and efficiency based on interaction logs showing five rounds of dialogue and retrieved images.
